name: v26.8.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix/sonarcloud unbounded recursion complexity by @sathyapramod in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5098
* feat: honor ANSIBLE_VAULT_PASSWORD_FILE for vault decryption by @JohnLahr in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5019
* fix: jinja[spacing] rule creating invalid syntax for minus modifiers by @Dotify71 in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5102
* chore(deps): update all dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5081
* chore(deps): update all dependencies pep621 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5082
* fix: remove stale words from cspell dictionary by @rockygeekz in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5109
* chore(deps): bump schemas npm packages for Dependabot CVEs by @sudhirverma in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5114
* fix(security): update dependencies [SECURITY] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5111
* fix: address SonarCloud new code violations by @sudhirverma in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5116
* chore(deps): update all dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5121
* chore(deps): update all dependencies pep621 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5122
* fix(deps): exclude ansible-core 2.17.x (CVE-2026-11332) by @rockygeekz in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5123
* fix: expose ansible-galaxy on the uv tool-install path by @jeffcpullen in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5124
* fix: var-naming for register projections by @0xTaoZ in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5110
* chore: Adding OpenWrt 25.12 as platform by @sscheib in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5132
* chore(deps): update all dependencies pep621 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5134
* chore(deps): update all dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5133
* fix: add timeout to release-check urlopen() call by @cooperlees in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5128
* fix: respect ANSIBLE_HOME env var for cache dir selection (#5806) by @Jkhall81 in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5105
* fix: deduplicate ANSIBLE_HOME isolation check by @rockygeekz in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5140
* fix(security): update dependencies [SECURITY] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5141
* fix: do not require role prefix for ansible_ connection variables by @Sanjays2402 in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5130
* Adding missing FreeBSD versions. by @jmpalacios in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5143
* chore(deps): update all dependencies pep621 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5139
* fix: prepend runtime cache dir to collections paths (#5137) by @rockygeekz in https://github.com/ansible/ansible-lint/pull/5145
